# COIN (Coinbase Global, Inc., NMS) technical report, as of 2026-11-19

## 1. Summary

COIN is in a sharp, persistent downtrend and is oversold. The latest verified close is **108.87**, the lowest close in the 2026-05-19 to 2026-11-19 data window I pulled. Every trend and momentum tool I used agrees on direction. Price sits below all of its moving averages, MACD is deepening below zero, and RSI is below 30. No tool output shows a reversal signal yet. The main open question is whether this is a capitulation low or a trend continuation. The data can't settle that, so the report lays out conditions to watch for each case.

**Data integrity:** The indicator values from `get_indicators` match the verified snapshot for the 10 EMA, 50 SMA, 200 SMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger lower band and ATR, so I found no discrepancies. VWMA is not in the snapshot. Its value comes only from `get_indicators` and is unverified against the snapshot. The 2026-11-19 volume (7,827,963) is formatted differently from the rounded figures on earlier rows. It may be a partial or in-progress session, but I can't confirm that.

## 2. Indicators selected and why

| Role | Indicator | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Long-term trend | close_200_sma | Strategic trend benchmark |
| Medium-term trend | close_50_sma | Dynamic resistance and trend direction |
| Short-term momentum | close_10_ema | Fast read on trend shifts and rebound attempts |
| Momentum/trend change | macd (with macds/macdh from the snapshot) | Momentum strength and signal-line relationship |
| Overbought/oversold | rsi | Flags exhaustion and divergence |
| Volatility/range | boll_lb (with boll and boll_ub from the snapshot) | Oversold-zone reference and band width |
| Risk sizing | atr | Stop distance and position size |
| Volume-confirmed trend | vwma | Checks whether volume supports the price trend |

These cover trend, momentum, volatility and volume without redundancy. I skipped macds and macdh as separate calls and used the snapshot values for them.

## 3. Price action (verified closes)

- **Prior peak:** The window high was 208.33 on 2026-09-21, with closes near 201 on 09-21 and 09-22.
- **Slide from late October:** The close was 160.59 on 10-29. On 10-30 it fell to 143.54 on 20.89M shares, the heaviest volume in the recent 30 sessions and a heavy-volume break lower. By my arithmetic from those closes, that is about −10.6% in one day.
- **Failed bounce:** The close rose to 151.50 on 11-04, then fell to 136.82 on 11-05. Highs since then have been lower.
- **Latest leg:** The close has fallen on six consecutive sessions, from 136.27 on 11-11 to 108.87 on 11-19. By my arithmetic from the closes, the move from 160.59 (10-29) to 108.87 is about −32%.
- **Gap down:** The 11-16 high (122.99) was below the 11-13 low (125.38). That leaves an unfilled gap of 122.99 to 125.38 above current prices. The 11-16 close was 119.84 on 11.2M volume.
- **Lower highs:** Daily highs were 121.61 on 11-17, 115.70 on 11-18 and 115.54 on 11-19. Each session failed to retest the prior day's high.
- **Today:** The range was 108.80 to 115.54, so the close of 108.87 is essentially at the low of the day. There was no intraday recovery. The open was 114.43.
- **Full retracement:** The close is now below the 146.23 close of 2026-08-18, where the August to September rally began. That rally has been completely given back.

## 4. Indicator readings (verified snapshot, 2026-11-19)

### Trend
- **10 EMA: 123.98.** Price is about 15 below it. The EMA has fallen steadily from 176.57 on 10-21, so short-term momentum is down.
- **50 SMA: 165.26.** This is well above price and still falling (178.37 on 10-20, 180.32 on 10-29).
- **200 SMA: 172.67.** This is also falling (181.70 on 10-20).
- **50 below 200:** The 50 SMA has been below the 200 SMA throughout the 30-day window I pulled, so it is a bearish configuration. The gap widened from about 3.3 on 10-20 to about 7.4 now. I can't tell from this window when the cross happened.
- **VWMA: 131.04** (not in the snapshot). It is below the 50 and 200 SMAs and about 22 above price. It fell from 170.80 on 10-29. The volume-weighted average being well above price means heavy-volume trading has occurred at much higher prices, so there are trapped holders overhead.

### Momentum
- **MACD: −15.02,** below the signal line (−12.62), with a histogram of −2.41. MACD has weakened every session in the window shown, from −2.38 on 10-20 to −15.02. The negative histogram means the gap to the signal line is still widening. No bullish crossover is visible.
- **RSI: 25.26,** the lowest reading in the window and in oversold territory (below 30). RSI was 31.91 on 10-30 and 29.70 on 11-02, and it bounced to 40.65 on 11-04. The close on 11-02 was 137.83 and today's is 108.87, but RSI made a lower low as well (25.26 vs 29.70). **There is no bullish divergence.** Momentum is confirming the price low rather than warning of exhaustion. In strong downtrends RSI can stay below 30 for extended periods.

### Volatility
- **Bollinger bands:** the lower band is 104.01, the middle 138.75 and the upper 173.50. The close is 4.86 above the lower band, and today's low (108.80) did not touch it. The lower band has been falling quickly (114.69 on 11-16, 110.66 on 11-17, 107.49 on 11-18, 104.01 on 11-19), so price has been running along the lower band. The very wide bands (about 69 from lower to upper) show how much volatility has expanded. A close back above the middle band (138.75) would be a far bigger recovery than the first rebound attempts.
- **ATR: 9.02,** about 8.3% of the closing price. It has eased from 11.06 on 11-05, so daily ranges are somewhat smaller despite the lower price. Volatility is still high in percentage terms.

## 5. What this means

**Bearish case (what the data currently shows):**
- Price is below the 10 EMA, VWMA, Bollinger middle, 50 SMA and 200 SMA, in that order of proximity.
- MACD momentum is worsening, and RSI has made a lower low with no divergence.
- The sequence of lower highs and an unfilled gap above are ongoing resistance.
- The 11-19 close at the day's low shows no buying response so far.

**Rebound case (what would need to appear):**
- RSI is below 30, so a snap-back rally is statistically plausible. Nothing in the data shows one beginning.
- Signs of a base would be a close well above the day's range, a higher low in price with RSI above today's 25.26, or the MACD histogram shrinking toward zero.
- A rebound would first meet resistance near the unfilled gap (122.99–125.38), the 10 EMA (123.98), and then VWMA (131.04). Given the falling 10 EMA, these levels are moving lower each day.

**Caveat on levels:** I have no historical bounce data for any of these levels in the tool output. They are reference points based on the numbers above, not validated support or resistance. The only downside reference is the lower Bollinger band (104.01), which moves daily. Below it there is no price history in the window to anchor on, since 108.80 is the lowest low in the data.

## 6. Risk management (ATR-based, illustrative)
- At an ATR of 9.02, a 1.5× ATR stop is about 13.5 points and a 2× ATR stop is about 18 points. Measured from the 108.87 close, those would sit around 95.3 and 90.9.
- With daily ranges around 8% of price, position size should be sized to the stop distance rather than to a fixed share count.
- Catching a falling move below the lower band is high risk. Waiting for confirmation (such as a close above the 10 EMA or a MACD histogram turning up) trades a worse entry price for better information.
- The 10-30 and 07-31 sessions (20.9M each) show that sharp high-volume gap days occur in this stock, so overnight risk is real.
